field_description: Unique identifier for a future collected evidence item, e.g. EV-DEC06-001. Not yet assigned to any record.
One of the eight classes defined in SLR_DEC_06_EVIDENCE_GAP_PLAN.md Sec.5.
Exact title of the evidence item as published by its issuing body.
The organization, standard-issuing body, or named author(s) responsible for the item.
Publication or most recent update date of the item, as stated by the issuing body.
Official URL or bibliographic locator for the item. Must resolve to the issuing body's own publication, not a third-party summary.
Basis for treating the issuing body as authoritative for this evidence class (e.g. standard-setting body, peer-reviewed venue, official provider documentation).
One or more of the nine K_6 components (concepts, variants, translations, syntax, filters, risk, seed checking, versioning, reporting) this item supports.
Exact section, page, or anchor within the item supporting the specific methodological claim used.
The specific methodological rule or recommendation extracted from the item, stated precisely.
The scope within which the rule applies (e.g. discipline, language, database type) and where it does not apply.
Stated or inferred limitation of the item's applicability to this SLR's context.
Reference to any other admissible evidence item that prescribes a materially incompatible rule for the same component (see C_abk in SLR_DEC_06_EVIDENCE_GAP_PLAN.md Sec.13), or NONE_FOUND.
Computed value of A_j^evidence = 1[I_j=M_j=D_j=P_j=L_j=1] per SLR_DEC_06_EVIDENCE_GAP_PLAN.md Sec.6, with each sub-indicator's basis stated.
One of: NOT_YET_DISCOVERED | DISCOVERED_PENDING_ADMISSIBILITY_REVIEW | ADMISSIBLE | INADMISSIBLE_WITH_REASON. No row in this turn may be anything other than the schema-definition state below.
Free-text notes, including any researcher-review flags.
